record_corrections_to_v2.reason: In Table 3 the two numbers after the skink columns ('2' and '4') start at x-positions 642 and 668, which are the dung-morphology frequency column and the observation count column, not the dung-morphology count and frequency columns used by every other row (607 and 642). Read as printed they are not a valid count and frequency pair for either method, so no tortoise detection can be stated. DNA metabarcoding gives 0 of 80.

The numbers '2 0' start at x-position 642 (dung-morphology frequency column). The count cannot be determined from the PDF. The article text states that tortoises disperse the seeds of this palm, so the record stays, without a number.

table_recheck.method: x-positions of the text fragments in the PDF (pypdf text visitor); the table is printed rotated
table_recheck.result: With the two displaced rows (Elaeodendron orientale, Latania loddigesii) left out, the dung-morphology column has 21 taxa, which equals the printed total. The unit-2 count of 23 came from reading those two rows as morphology counts.
table_recheck.status: resolved_for_the_column_total; the two displaced rows remain undeterminable
